query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revenueGoalHistory (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  goalId INT NOT NULL,
  previousAmount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  newAmount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  changedBy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  changedByName VARCHAR(200),
  reason TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX goal_idx (goalId)
)
